name: Aguigrenons

attributes.attribute: an enemy of the Round Table knights

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aguigrenons was a minor figure in the legends of the great knights of the Round Table. He was their enemy. The pure Percival finally defeated him.

okr.objective: Record Aguigrenons, an enemy of the Round Table knights.
key_results: Show his position as enemy and his defeat by Percival.
